3558.title: Hidden automation tabs forward native focus events
3558.rootCauseOneLine: Hidden native focus events bypass a visibility check; ordinary controller activity triggering these events remains unverified.
3558.proposedFix: First trace native focus and app callbacks in an isolated two-thread desktop; only then select a visibility or activation fix.
3558.caveats: Injected-event unit reproduction only; no native desktop focus theft or screenshot reproduced. No production fix or PR.
